title: Cloud threads follow the same model rules as local sessions
why: Your question, Oct 26: cloud threads run Opus, but you can't see or limit which models their subagents get, unlike the lockdown claude-settings gives your local sessions.
note: Checked Oct 26 in a cloud thread at claude-settings 149f4bc. Local lockdown = settings.json env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet and CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet, the guard's subagent-model-cap ask on any write that lifts them, and agents/ files with model pins (5 haiku, plan opus). In the cloud none of it is there: no ~/.claude/agents, neither env var set (only CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1), no hooks. CLAUDE.md's roles rules do load, so the Sonnet ceiling is followed only by instruction, unchecked. So cloud subagents inherit the thread's Opus unless the thread passes a model. This project runs on the built-in cloud environment, which has no settings. Proposal, three parts. (1) Now, your action, no code: in Project settings, Cloud environment, Add cloud environment, set the same two env vars to sonnet; new threads then cap subagents the way your machines do. Unknown: how the env cap interacts with an agent file's own model pin (Plan on Opus); not checked. (2) With batch 1: a report rule for cloud threads, each Done item names the model of each subagent that worked on it, so you can see it; a reviewer checks it against the spawn calls. (3) Later, its own step: install claude-settings into cloud containers through a project SessionStart hook (guards, agents, env), which also closes 'hooks are not installed in cloud sessions' from c52. Unknown whether a repo's .claude/settings.json hook loads when the thread starts in /home/claude rather than in the repo. Advisor pick on order: part 1 now (independent of c53); part 2 after c53; part 3 after batch 1. Your action, Oct 26: part 1 done. You made a new cloud environment with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL set to sonnet, now the project default; threads started before it (this one included) keep the old environment. Part 3 has two routes: the environment's setup script, or a repo SessionStart hook. Your ruling, Oct 26: hold part 3 until you choose to do it.
ask: Part 1 done (your settings change, Oct 26). Part 2 gets a brief after c53. Part 3 held until you choose.
